categories.main_business_segments: VISION INC. operates three main business segments: Global WiFi (offering mobile WiFi router rental services for international and domestic travelers), Information and Communication Services (including fixed-line and mobile communication services, broadband, OA equipment sales, and internet media), and Glamping & Tourism (operating glamping facilities and inbound tourism services).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages partnerships with global and domestic telecom carriers to procure local network access, providing mobile WiFi routers for rental. It utilizes web marketing, direct sales, and a hybrid sales model (Vision Hybrid Synergy Model) to efficiently capture demand. Internal system development and database management are handled by group companies, supporting operational efficiency and data-driven strategy.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include international and domestic travelers (both leisure and business), corporations (especially those with frequent overseas travel), SMEs, SOHO businesses, and inbound tourists. The company also serves general consumers and businesses needing communication infrastructure, OA equipment, and digital marketing solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: VISION INC. is headquartered in Tokyo and operates extensively across Japan, with sales offices in major cities and airport counters nationwide. Internationally, it has subsidiaries and operations in South Korea, the US (California, Hawaii, New York), Hong Kong, Taiwan, Singapore, the UK, France, Italy, Vietnam, China, and New Caledonia, enabling global WiFi coverage.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the downstream segment, acting as a service aggregator and distributor by procuring network access and devices from telecom carriers and manufacturers, then providing value-added rental and sales services directly to end-users and corporate clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding brand recognition (especially for Global WiFi), strengthening stable recurring revenue through stock-type services, broadening product offerings and sales channels, and pursuing M&A for business expansion. The company emphasizes sustainability, digital transformation (DX), and operational efficiency, but does not report significant proprietary R&D activities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the rental of mobile WiFi routers (daily/period-based), sales of OA and communication equipment, commissions from telecom service subscriptions, and glamping facility accommodation fees. Additional income comes from digital marketing services, space rentals, and support services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other domestic and international mobile WiFi rental providers, telecom carriers, and OA equipment resellers. VISION INC. differentiates itself through its broad service area, hybrid sales model, and strong presence at airports. The company holds a leading position in the Japanese outbound and inbound WiFi rental market and is expanding its presence in the corporate and tourism sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For FY2024, consolidated net sales were approximately 35.5 billion yen, with operating profit of 5.4 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 3.4 billion yen. The company has demonstrated strong growth, with sales and profits increasing year-over-year, and maintains a high equity ratio (69.1%) and robust cash position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: VISION INC. offers reliable, convenient, and competitively priced global and domestic mobile internet access, supported by a wide range of service plans, extensive airport presence, and a seamless customer experience. Its hybrid sales approach, strong data-driven marketing, and ability to cross-sell communication and IT solutions to businesses provide further differentiation and customer value.
